entities.name: Spanish Colonial Decline and Neglect
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: As Spain focused on its wealthier Mexican and Peruvian colonies, Santo Domingo fell into economic decline. Cattle ranching replaced sugar as the main economy. French buccaneers and settlers occupied the western portion of Hispaniola.
